headlines.title: BILL Holdings (BILL) vs. INTU and PYPL: Can Its Financial Workflow Platform Become a Long-Term Compounder?
headlines.summary: Is BILL a good stock to buy? We came across a bullish thesis on BILL Holdings, Inc. on TradersPro’s Substack. Since the thesis was published on August 29th, BILL shares have edged lower as investors weighed its 9–12% FY27 revenue-growth outlook, keeping the recovery in check while its expanding AI capabilities remain a longer-term opportunity.

headlines.title: Barclays lowers PayPal stock to Underweight on slowing fundamentals
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays downgraded PayPal to Underweight from Equal Weight and cut its price target to $53 from $56, flagging slowing growth in its core checkout business, secular pressure on its branded button and a reduced chance of a takeover.

headlines.title: 2 profitable stocks on our watchlist and 1 we question
headlines.summary: Even if a company is profitable, it doesn’t always mean it’s a great investment. Some struggle to maintain growth, face looming threats, or fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their future potential.

headlines.title: Is PayPal Stock a Value or a Value Trap?
headlines.summary: PayPal is cheap, but does it make the stock a buy?

headlines.title: Down 82% from all-time highs, can PayPal stock finally recover in 2027?
headlines.summary: PayPal stock is down 82% from its peak. Q3 results show Venmo, Pay Later and cost cuts working, but is 2027 the year the PayPal comeback finally shows?

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
